maddeler.e:
ننصرم (form VII)
# نَنْصَرِمُ (nanṣarimu) /nan.sˤa.ri.mu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِنْصَرَمَ (inṣarama)
# نَنْصَرِمَ (nanṣarima) /nan.sˤa.ri.ma/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِنْصَرَمَ (inṣarama)
# نَنْصَرِمْ (nanṣarim) /nan.sˤa.rim/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِنْصَرَمَ (inṣarama)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
